explanation: Keep a 64-bit global offset and store each client credit minus that offset in a hash map. A balanced ordered set ranks pairs of normalized credit and client ID; adding the same offset preserves this ranking. Insertion removes any old pair before adding the replacement. The operation adapter checks every query and removal, including Max, and recreates the database for each constructor/reset command.
timeComplexity: Insert/Remove: O(log n) expected; Lookup: O(1) expected; AddAll: O(1); Max: O(log n), excluding identifier hashing/comparison costs. Constructor/reset clears O(n) retained entries.
spaceComplexity: O(n) retained client and ranking entries.
attribution: Original Java implementation and complete reset-aware operation adapter independently authored for EPI Practice from its displayed credit-database contract.
